purpose: Teach: 集結/論評/開館/取り込む/愛称/利率/換金/代弁

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 全部署を会議室に集結させましょう
lines.en: Let's get all departments into the conference room.
lines.style: Brisk, efficient opening. Short breath before launching into the directive. Forward momentum. No pause for discussion—this is a proposal already decided.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お取引先からの論評をまとめました
lines.en: Yes. I've compiled the feedback from our partner.
lines.style: Clean, responsive tone. Light emphasis on the completion—work done, ready to report. Respectful but matter-of-fact. No elaboration needed.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 新ショールームの開館式を準備しましょう
lines.en: Let's prepare for the new showroom's opening ceremony.
lines.style: Clear directive, same register as the first. Slightly slower than the opening—giving room for the magnitude of the event to land. Purposeful, not rushed.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お客様の声を商品開発に取り込む方針です
lines.en: Yes. Our approach is to incorporate customer feedback into product development.
lines.style: Explanatory, but not defensive. Steady delivery of policy. Voice slightly elevated—he's outlining the reasoning, not just confirming receipt. Warm competence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 社内サークルに愛称をつけましょう
lines.en: Let's give the in-house circles nicknames.
lines.style: Same forward momentum as before. Slightly lighter here—a smaller, more human initiative. Still directive, but with a touch of levity underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。取引銀行の利率改定の案内が届きました
lines.en: Yes. We've received notice of a rate revision from our bank.
lines.style: Factual report. Calm delivery of important information. No urgency in the tone, but clear respect for the content. Straightforward.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 海外通貨の換金手続を簡略化しましょう
lines.en: Let's simplify the foreign currency exchange procedures.
lines.style: Operational directive, matching the cadence of earlier proposals. Matter-of-fact efficiency. The practical manager thinking through processes.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の懸念を経営陣に代弁いたします
lines.en: Yes. I will represent our valued clients' concerns to the management team.
lines.style: Formal closure. Slightly more formal register here—he's speaking of representation and advocacy. Warm but dignified. Breath of commitment at the end.
